blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filinvest REIT Corp. (FILRT) grew its nine-month net income 28 percent to P1.3 billion as Festival Main Mall lifted revenues while expenses grew modestly. On Wednesday, the company, backed by Filinvest Land Inc., reported revenues of P3 billion in the January-to-September period, up 18 percent from a year earlier. READ: FILRT H1 profit jumps 34% on mall contribution Festival Main Mall, which joined FILRT’s portfolio in May 2025, contributed to the revenue increase.
